segments.name: Power
segments.description: Originates, develops and manages powered land and energy infrastructure, including interconnects, substations, switchyards and generation assets, supporting downstream data center deployment.
segments.evidence: The Power business segment consists of revenue streams related to Power Generation and Managed Services.

segments.name: Digital Infrastructure
segments.description: Develops, owns and operates data center facilities for energy-intensive technology applications, leasing capacity to hosting, colocation and AI computing customers.
segments.evidence: The Digital Infrastructure business segment consist of revenue streams related to CPU Colocation and ASIC Colocation services.

segments.name: Compute
segments.description: Operates businesses that deploy and monetize compute assets across energy-intensive technology end markets, including bitcoin mining and cloud services.
segments.evidence: The Compute business segment consists of revenue streams related to ASIC Compute, AI Cloud, and Traditional Cloud operations.

segments.name: Other
segments.description: Captures activities outside the Power, Digital Infrastructure and Compute layers, currently equipment sales and repairs.
segments.evidence: The Other business segments consists of revenue related to Equipment Sales and Repairs.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for data center hosting, leasing and colocation, compute and cloud services, and equipment, while grid operators pay for power capacity and electricity.
revenueModel.evidence: We seek to monetize our Digital Infrastructure assets through a range of commercial structures, including long-term hosting, leasing, or colocation agreements.

changes.text: In 2024 the company changed its reportable segments, recasting prior results to the new Power, Digital Infrastructure, Compute and Other segments.
changes.evidence: The Company changed its reportable segments during the year ended December 31, 2024 to better align with the Company's objectives; accordingly, the results from the six months ended December 31, 2023 were recast to align with the new reportable segments.

changes.text: In 2025 the company agreed to sell all of its equity interests in the Far North power generation joint venture.
changes.evidence: During the twelve months ended December 31, 2025, the Company entered into an agreement to sell all of its equity interests in the Far North JV.
